name: Example Contributor
contribution: Built a tiny app that turns coffee notes into shareable project cards.
headline: From cafe idea to demo board
summary: This sample entry shows the exact shape every contributor can copy on event day.
body:
I made a simple prototype that takes rough project notes and formats them into a clean card + detail view.

This board keeps the process easy: copy the template JSON, fill your details, and optionally add a cover image.
